name: After § 26
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 26d. Stresses the need to retain the integrity and fundamental nature of the CAP, including dedicated funding for both pillars, and rejects any kind of policy mix under the proposed NRPP Regulation, as this would exacerbate territorial inequalities; stresses that direct payments generate clear EU added value and should continue to support income stability, high-quality production and protection against price volatility, but should also be better targeted to active farmers and the provision of public goods;
